<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Vegan Ramen</title>
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
      margin: 0;
      padding: 0;
    }

    html, body {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      background-color: #0b0807;
      user-select: none;
      -webkit-user-select: none;
      cursor: grab;
    }

    body:active {
      cursor: grabbing;
    }

    canvas {
      display: block;
      width: 100vw;
      height: 100vh;
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <canvas id="scene" aria-label="A steaming bowl of rich vegan tantanmen ramen in a warm, dark atmospheric setting"></canvas>

  <script>
    (() => {
      const canvas = document.getElementById('scene');
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');

      // Accessibility: respect prefers-reduced-motion
      const motionQuery = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
      let prefersReducedMotion = motionQuery.matches;
      motionQuery.addEventListener('change', (e) => {
        prefersReducedMotion = e.matches;
      });

      // Deterministic PRNG for procedural textures and organic placement
      function createPRNG(seed) {
        let s = seed % 2147483647;
        if (s <= 0) s += 2147483646;
        return function() {
          s = (s * 16807) % 2147483647;
          return (s - 1) / 2147483646;
        };
      }

      // Viewport & Coordinate State
      let width = window.innerWidth;
      let height = window.innerHeight;
      let dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
      let scale = 1;
      let centerX = width / 2;
      let centerY = height / 2;

      // Mouse & Interactive Physics State (in normalized scene units where bowl radius ~ 300)
      const pointer = {
        x: 0,
        y: -80,
        targetX: 0,
        targetY: -80,
        vx: 0,
        vy: 0,
        nx: 0, // -1 to 1 across screen
        ny: 0,
        targetNx: 0,
        targetNy: 0,
        active: false,
        down: false
      };

      // Broth Ripples triggered by mouse movement or click inside the soup
      const ripples = [];

      function addRipple(x, y, strength = 1, maxRadius = 110) {
        if (prefersReducedMotion) return;
        // Check if within elliptical broth boundary: (x/290)^2 + ((y+38)/195)^2 <= 1
        const dx = x / 290;
        const dy = (y + 38) / 195;
        if (dx * dx + dy * dy <= 0.95) {
          ripples.push({
            x,
            y,
            radius: 4,
            maxRadius,
            alpha: Math.min(0.65, 0.35 * strength),
            speed: 45 + strength * 25
          });
          if (ripples.length > 18) ripples.shift();
        }
      }

      function updateViewport() {
        width = window.innerWidth;
        height = window.innerHeight;
        dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
        canvas.width = Math.round(width * dpr);
        canvas.height = Math.round(height * dpr);
        // Base design is 1000x850 virtual units
        scale = Math.min(width / 960, height / 820);
        centerX = width / 2;
        centerY = height * 0.53;
      }

      window.addEventListener('resize', updateViewport);
      updateViewport();

      function handlePointerMove(clientX, clientY) {
        pointer.targetNx = (clientX / width - 0.5) * 2;
        pointer.targetNy = (clientY / height - 0.5) * 2;
        const sceneX = (clientX - centerX) / scale;
        const sceneY = (clientY - centerY) / scale;
        const prevX = pointer.targetX;
        const prevY = pointer.targetY;
        pointer.targetX = sceneX;
        pointer.targetY = sceneY;
        pointer.active = true;

        const dist = Math.hypot(sceneX - prevX, sceneY - prevY);
        if (dist > 6 && Math.random() < 0.45) {
          addRipple(sceneX, sceneY, Math.min(dist / 25, 1.4), 75 + Math.random() * 40);
        }
      }

      window.addEventListener('pointermove', (e) => {
        handlePointerMove(e.clientX, e.clientY);
      });

      window.addEventListener('pointerdown', (e) => {
        pointer.down = true;
        handlePointerMove(e.clientX, e.clientY);
        const sceneX = ( e.clientX - centerX ) / scale;
        const sceneY = ( e.clientY - centerY ) / scale;
        addRipple(sceneX, sceneY, 1.8, 150);
        // Boost nearby velocity for steam swirl
        pointer.vx += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 45;
        pointer.vy -= 30;
      });

      window.addEventListener('pointerup', () => {
        pointer.down = false;
      });

      // ==========================================
      // PROCEDURAL SCENE ELEMENTS GENERATION
      // ==========================================
      const rand = createPRNG(849201);

      // 1. Ceramic Bowl Glaze Speckles & Ribbing
      const ceramicSpeckles = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 160; i++) {
        const angle = rand() * Math.PI; // front half of bowl
        const rNorm = Math.pow(rand(), 0.75);
        ceramicSpeckles.push({
          x: (rand() - 0.5) * 620,
          y: -25 + rand() * 235,
          r: 0.7 + rand() * 1.8,
          alpha: 0.08 + rand() * 0.22,
          warm: rand() > 0.4
        });
      }

      // 2. Wavy Alkaline Ramen Noodles (Multi-layered Bezier splines)
      const noodleStrands = [];
      const noodleCount = 38;
      for (let i = 0; i < noodleCount; i++) {
        const yBase = -75 + (i / noodleCount) * 165 + (rand() - 0.5) * 18;
        const xSpan = 215 * Math.sqrt(Math.max(0.15, 1 - Math.pow((yBase + 15) / 145, 2)));
        const startX = -xSpan * (0.65 + rand() * 0.35);
        const endX = xSpan * (0.65 + rand() * 0.35);
        const waveFreq = 3.2 + rand() * 2.5;
        const waveAmp = 8 + rand() * 11;
        const phase = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
        const depth = i / noodleCount; // 0 = deeper, 1 = closer to surface
        noodleStrands.push({
          startX,
          endX,
          yBase,
          waveFreq,
          waveAmp,
          phase,
          depth,
          thickness: 5.2 + rand() * 2.4,
          hueShift: (rand() - 0.5) * 8
        });
      }

      // 3. Chili Oil (Rayu) Droplets & Glossy Pools
      const chiliDroplets = [];
      const dropletClusters = [
        { cx: -15, cy: 55, spread: 95, count: 42 },
        { cx: 95, cy: 48, spread: 80, count: 35 },
        { cx: -185, cy: 10, spread: 60, count: 24 },
        { cx: 18, cy: -30, spread: 70, count: 26 },
        { cx: 185, cy: -5, spread: 55, count: 22 }
      ];
      dropletClusters.forEach(cluster => {
        for (let i = 0; i < cluster.count; i++) {
          const a = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
          const dist = Math.pow(rand(), 0.65) * cluster.spread;
          const rx = 2.2 + Math.pow(rand(), 2.2) * 16;
          chiliDroplets.push({
            baseX: cluster.cx + Math.cos(a) * dist,
            baseY: cluster.cy + Math.sin(a) * dist * 0.65,
            r: rx,
            stretch: 0.62 + rand() * 0.16,
            rot: (rand() - 0.5) * 0.5,
            phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
            speed: 0.6 + rand() * 0.9,
            deepColor: rand() > 0.3 ? '#9e1905' : '#b82807',
            brightColor: '#ff5912'
          });
        }
      });

      // 4. Charred Sweet Corn Kernels (Cluster at lower-left)
      const cornKernels = [];
      const cornCenter = { x: -135, y: 58 };
      for (let i = 0; i < 44; i++) {
        const a = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
        const rad = Math.pow(rand(), 0.58) * 68;
        const kx = cornCenter.x + Math.cos(a) * rad * 1.1;
        const ky = cornCenter.y + Math.sin(a) * rad * 0.68;
        const isCharred = rand() < 0.38;
        cornKernels.push({
          x: kx,
          y: ky,
          rot: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
          rx: 6.5 + rand() * 2.2,
          ry: 5.0 + rand() * 1.6,
          isCharred,
          charSpotAngle: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
          shade: rand()
        });
      }
      cornKernels.sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);

      // 5. Spicy Crumbled Tofu & Shiitake Soboro (Lower-right / center-right mound)
      const soboroPieces = [];
      const soboroCenter = { x: 85, y: 65 };
      for (let i = 0; i < 65; i++) {
        const a = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
        const rad = Math.pow(rand(), 0.6) * 66;
        const sx = soboroCenter.x + Math.cos(a) * rad * 1.15;
        const sy = soboroCenter.y + Math.sin(a) * rad * 0.65;
        soboroPieces.push({
          x: sx,
          y: sy,
          r: 4.5 + rand() * 6.5,
          rot: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
          lobe1: 0.7 + rand() * 0.5,
          lobe2: 0.7 + rand() * 0.5,
          tone: rand() // 0: dark charred umami, 1: chili-glazed warm brown
        });
      }
      soboroPieces.sort((a, b) => a.y - b.y);

      // 6. Finely Sliced Scallion Rings (Negi)
      const scallions = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 38; i++) {
        const a = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
        const rad = Math.pow(rand(), 0.6) * 58;
        const sx = -25 + Math.cos(a) * rad * 1.1 + (rand() - 0.5) * 35;
        const sy = 5 + Math.sin(a) * rad * 0.75 + (rand() - 0.5) * 25;
        scallions.push({
          x: sx,
          y: sy,
          rx: 6 + rand() * 4.5,
          ry: 3.8 + rand() * 3.0,
          rot: rand() * Math.PI,
          thickness: 1.8 + rand() * 1.4,
          lightGreen: rand() > 0.45
        });
      }

      // 7. Toasted White & Black Sesame Seeds + Ito Togarashi (Chili Threads)
      const sesameSeeds = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 115; i++) {
        const a = rand() * Math.PI * 2;
        const rad = Math.pow(rand(), 0.55) * 235;
        const sx = Math.cos(a) * rad;
        const sy = -32 + Math.sin(a) * rad * 0.62;
        sesameSeeds.push({
          x: sx,
          y: sy,
          rot: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
          isBlack: rand() < 0.28,
          scale: 0.85 + rand() * 0.35
        });
      }

      const chiliThreads = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 22; i++) {
        const cx = -30 + (rand() - 0.5) * 90;
        const cy = 0 + (rand() - 0.5) * 55;
        chiliThreads.push({
          x: cx,
          y: cy,
          len: 18 + rand() * 22,
          curve: (rand() - 0.5) * 25,
          angle: rand() * Math.PI * 2
        });
      }

      // 8. Volumetric Multi-Layered Steam Plumes & Rising Warm Micro-Mist
      const steamRibbons = [];
      const ribbonCount = 9;
      for (let i = 0; i < ribbonCount; i++) {
        steamRibbons.push({
          baseX: -175 + (i / (ribbonCount - 1)) * 350 + (rand() - 0.5) * 25,
          baseY: -45 + (rand() - 0.5) * 75,
          phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2,
          speed: 0.55 + rand() * 0.35,
          width: 48 + rand() * 42,
          height: 290 + rand() * 120,
          alpha: 0.042 + rand() * 0.038,
          swayAmp: 22 + rand() * 20
        });
      }

      const steamPuffs = [];
      const puffCount = 42;
      for (let i = 0; i < puffCount; i++) {
        steamPuffs.push(createSteamPuff(rand, true));
      }

      function createSteamPuff(rng = Math.random, randomProgress = false) {
        const progress = randomProgress ? rng() : 0;
        const startX = (rng() - 0.5) * 410;
        const startY = -35 + (rng() - 0.5) * 110;
        return {
          startX,
          startY,
          x: startX,
          y: startY - progress * 380,
          vx: 0,
          vy: -(0.45 + rng() * 0.55),
          r: 28 + rng() * 42,
          progress,
          speed: 0.0018 + rng() * 0.0016,
          phase: rng() * Math.PI * 2,
          driftAmp: 15 + rng() * 25,
          maxAlpha: 0.045 + rng() * 0.045
        };
      }

      // Ambient floating heat motes around the dark background
      const heatMotes = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
        heatMotes.push({
          x: (rand() - 0.5) * 780,
          y: 120 - rand() * 560,
          r: 1.0 + rand() * 2.2,
          alpha: 0.08 + rand() * 0.25,
          speedY: 0.15 + rand() * 0.35,
          phase: rand() * Math.PI * 2
        });
      }

      // ==========================================
      // DRAWING HELPER FUNCTIONS
      // ==========================================

      function drawWoodTableAndMat(px, py) {
        ctx.save();
        // Rich warm spotlight on dark charred timber surface
        const tableGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          px * 15, 70 + py * 10, 40,
          0, 80, 750
        );
        tableGrad.addColorStop(0, '#2a1810');
        tableGrad.addColorStop(0.42, '#170d09');
        tableGrad.addColorStop(0.78, '#0c0705');
        tableGrad.addColorStop(1, '#060403');
        ctx.fillStyle = tableGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(-width / scale, -height / scale, (width * 2) / scale, (height * 2) / scale);

        // Subtle horizontal wood grain lines on tabletop
        ctx.save();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 165, 105, 0.024)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        for (let y = -120; y < 440; y += 18) {
          const yPos = y + py * 6;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-680, yPos);
          ctx.bezierCurveTo(-220, yPos + Math.sin(y * 0.05) * 8, 220, yPos - Math.cos(y * 0.04) * 8, 680, yPos);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        ctx.restore();

        // Woven Slate-Bamboo Coaster / Trivet under the bowl
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(px * -8, 175 + py * -6);

        // Mat Drop Shadow
        const matShadow = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 12, 50, 0, 12, 340);
        matShadow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85)');
        matShadow.addColorStop(0.7, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)');
        matShadow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = matShadow;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 12, 340, 125, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Woven Mat Body
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 285, 96, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        const matGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-285, -60, 285, 80);
        matGrad.addColorStop(0, '#241a14');
        matGrad.addColorStop(0.5, '#1b130e');
        matGrad.addColorStop(1, '#110b08');
        ctx.fillStyle = matGrad;
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.lineWidth = 3;
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#33241b';
        ctx.stroke();

        // Bamboo slats texture clipped to coaster
        ctx.clip();
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 200, 150, 0.045)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        for (let sy = -95; sy <= 95; sy += 7) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(-290, sy);
          ctx.lineTo(290, sy);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        // Vertical binding threads on mat
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(15, 9, 6, 0.65)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 3.5;
        [-190, -110, 110, 190].forEach(bx => {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(bx, -100);
          ctx.lineTo(bx, 100);
          ctx.stroke();
        });
        ctx.restore();

        // Stray toasted sesame seeds on the wooden table for lived-in realism
        const tableSeeds = [
          { x: -245, y: 245, r: 0.4 },
          { x: -228, y: 256, r: 1.2 },
          { x: 260, y: 230, r: -0.6 }
        ];
        tableSeeds.forEach(s => {
          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(s.x - px * 6, s.y - py * 5);
          ctx.rotate(s.r);
          ctx.fillStyle = '#d9be91';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 3.2, 1.7, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
          ctx.restore();
        });

        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawChopsticksAndRest(px, py) {
        ctx.save();
        // Positioned resting behind/to the upper right of the bowl
        ctx.translate(px * -4, py * -4);

        // Smooth Dark River-Stone Chopstick Rest (Hashioki)
        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(295, -162);
        ctx.rotate(0.25);
        // Shadow
        ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.65)';
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(3, 8, 28, 14, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        // Stone body
        const stoneGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(-8, -5, 2, 0, 0, 28);
        stoneGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4a4440');
        stoneGrad.addColorStop(0.6, '#262220');
        stoneGrad.addColorStop(1, '#141110');
        ctx.fillStyle = stoneGrad;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 26, 13, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();
        ctx.restore();

        // Pair of Tapered Wooden Chopsticks with Crimson/Gold Lacquer Handles
        const sticks = [
          { x1: -65, y1: -255, x2: 375, y2: -145 },
          { x1: -55, y1: -238, x2: 382, y2: -124 }
        ];

        sticks.forEach((st, idx) => {
          ctx.save();
          // Cast shadow
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)';
          ctx.lineWidth = 8;
          ctx.lineCap = 'round';
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(st.x1 + 4, st.y1 + 12);
          ctx.lineTo(st.x2 + 4, st.y2 + 12);
          ctx.stroke();

          // Main wooden shaft
          const angle = Math.atan2(st.y2 - st.y1, st.x2 - st.x1);
          const len = Math.hypot(st.x2 - st.x1, st.y2 - st.y1);
          ctx.translate(st.x1, st.y1);
          ctx.rotate(angle);

          // Tapered polygon from tip (left, 3.5px) to handle (right, 8.5px)
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(0, -1.8);
          ctx.lineTo(len, -4.4);
          ctx.lineTo(len, 4.4);
          ctx.lineTo(0, 1.8);
          ctx.closePath();

          const woodGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -4, 0, 4);
          woodGrad.addColorStop(0, '#6e472b');
          woodGrad.addColorStop(0.35, '#96643e');
          woodGrad.addColorStop(0.8, '#4a2c18');
          woodGrad.addColorStop(1, '#2b180c');
          ctx.fillStyle = woodGrad;
          ctx.fill();

          // Dark crimson lacquer on the thick handle end
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(len * 0.68, -3.5);
          ctx.lineTo(len, -4.4);
          ctx.lineTo(len, 4.4);
          ctx.lineTo(len * 0.68, 3.5);
          ctx.closePath();
          const lacquerGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -4, 0, 4);
          lacquerGrad.addColorStop(0, '#7a1c14');
          lacquerGrad.addColorStop(0.3, '#a8291d');
          lacquerGrad.addColorStop(0.85, '#420c07');
          lacquerGrad.addColorStop(1, '#290603');
          ctx.fillStyle = lacquerGrad;
          ctx.fill();

          // Delicate gold ring accent at the lacquer transition
          ctx.fillStyle = '#e0ac53';
          ctx.fillRect(len * 0.68, -3.5, 4.5, 7.0);
          ctx.fillRect(len * 0.705, -3.6, 2.0, 7.2);

          ctx.restore();
        });

        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawBowlBackAndInterior(px, py) {
        // Deep ambient shadow directly under ceramic foot
        const bowlShadow = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, 165, 30, 0, 165, 290);
        bowlShadow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.95)');
        bowlShadow.addColorStop(0.55, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75)');
        bowlShadow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = bowlShadow;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, 165, 285, 95, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.fill();

        // Outer Lip (Rim) - Handcrafted stoneware with warm kintsugi-like terracotta edge
        ctx.save();
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -55, 326, 224, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        const rimGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(-320, -240, 320, 150);
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0, '#4f3829');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0.25, '#2b201a');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0.55, '#3b2b22');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(0.85, '#634532');
        rimGrad.addColorStop(1, '#261b15');
        ctx.fillStyle = rimGrad;
        ctx.fill();

        // Inner Bowl Wall (above soup line)
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -53, 312, 213, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        const innerWallGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -265, 0, 160);
        innerWallGrad.addColorStop(0, '#141110');
        innerWallGrad.addColorStop(0.35, '#1f1916');
        innerWallGrad.addColorStop(0.75, '#2d221c');
        innerWallGrad.addColorStop(1, '#18120f');
        ctx.fillStyle = innerWallGrad;
        ctx.fill();

        // Subtle horizontal potter's wheel throw rings inside the upper rim
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255, 215, 180, 0.04)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5;
        for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) {
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, -51 + r * 3, 306 - r * 4, 208 - r * 3, 0, Math.PI * 1.05, Math.PI * 1.95);
          ctx.stroke();
        }

        // Traditional subtle red-gold Rim Accent Motif on upper-left inner wall
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(196, 68, 39, 0.45)';
        ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -53, 303, 206, 0, Math.PI * 1.12, Math.PI * 1.88);
        ctx.stroke();
        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawBrothAndContents(time, px, py) {
        ctx.save();
        // Clip everything in the soup to the inner bowl ellipse
        ctx.beginPath();
        ctx.ellipse(0, -36, 298, 198, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);
        ctx.clip();

        // 1. Creamy Vegan Sesame-Miso Tantanmen Broth Base
        const brothCenterX = -25 + px * 18;
        const brothCenterY = -45 + py * 14;
        const brothGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          brothCenterX, brothCenterY, 15,
          0, -36, 305
        );
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0, '#e39842');   // Warm golden sesame cream highlight
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0.38, '#cc7324'); // Rich amber-miso body
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0.72, '#9e4711'); // Deep roasted chili-sesame edge
        brothGrad.addColorStop(0.92, '#692706'); // Ambient bowl wall shadow
        brothGrad.addColorStop(1, '#3d1403');
        ctx.fillStyle = brothGrad;
        ctx.fillRect(-320, -250, 640, 440);

      function drawNoodles(time, px, py) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.lineCap = 'round';
        ctx.lineJoin = 'round';

        noodleStrands.forEach((n) => {
          const depthAlpha = 0.28 + n.depth * 0.68;
          const waveOffset = time * 1.15 + n.phase;
          const segments = 18;
          const dx = (n.endX - n.startX) / segments;

          // Build path points with subtle interactive displacement near pointer
          const pts = [];
          for (let s = 0; s <= segments; s++) {
            const x = n.startX + s * dx;
            const env = Math.sin((s / segments) * Math.PI); // taper wave at ends
            let y = n.yBase + Math.sin((s / segments) * Math.PI * n.waveFreq + waveOffset) * n.waveAmp * env;

            // Gentle noodle buoyancy response to cursor proximity
            const distToMouse = Math.hypot(x - pointer.x, y - pointer.y);
            if (distToMouse < 95) {
              const push = (1 - distToMouse / 95) * 6.5 * env;
              y += ((y - pointer.y) / (distToMouse + 1)) * push;
            }
            pts.push({ x, y });
          }

          // Broth shadow beneath strand
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y + 3);
          for (let s = 1; s < pts.length; s++) {
            const xc = (pts[s - 1].x + pts[s].x) / 2;
            const yc = (pts[s - 1].y + pts[s].y) / 2 + 3;
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(pts[s - 1].x, pts[s - 1].y + 3, xc, yc);
          }
          ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(92, 30, 4, ${depthAlpha * 0.55})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = n.thickness + 2.5;
          ctx.stroke();

          // Main golden-wheat alkaline noodle body
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y);
          for (let s = 1; s < pts.length; s++) {
            const xc = (pts[s - 1].x + pts[s].x) / 2;
            const yc = (pts[s - 1].y + pts[s].y) / 2;
            ctx.quadraticCurveTo(pts[s - 1].x, pts[s - 1].y, xc, yc);
          }
          const lightness = Math.round(58 + n.depth * 20);
          ctx.strokeStyle = `hsla(${38 + n.hueShift}, 82%, ${lightness}%, ${depthAlpha})`;
          ctx.lineWidth = n.thickness;
          ctx.stroke();

          // Glossy broth-coated specular ridge on upper noodle strands
          if (n.depth > 0.45) {
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.moveTo(pts[0].x, pts[0].y - 1.2);
            for (let s = 1; s < pts.length; s++) {
              const xc = (pts[s - 1].x + pts[s].x) / 2;
              const yc = (pts[s - 1].y + pts[s].y) / 2 - 1.2;
              ctx.quadraticCurveTo(pts[s - 1].x, pts[s - 1].y - 1.2, xc, yc);
            }
            ctx.strokeStyle = `rgba(255, 238, 195, ${(n.depth - 0.4) * 0.55})`;
            ctx.lineWidth = 1.6;
            ctx.stroke();
          }
        });

        ctx.restore();
      }

      function drawChiliOil(time, px, py) {
        ctx.save();

          const driftX = Math.sin(time * d.speed + d.phase) * 3.5;
          const driftY = Math.cos(time * d.speed * 0.8 + d.phase) * 2.2;
          let x = d.baseX + driftX;
          let y = d.baseY + driftY;

          // Subtle repulsion from cursor stirring the broth
          const dx = x - pointer.x;
          const dy = y - pointer.y;
          const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
          if (dist < 85) {
            const factor = (1 - dist / 85) * 10;
            x += (dx / (dist + 1)) * factor;
            y += (dy / (dist + 1)) * factor;
          }

          ctx.save();
          ctx.translate(x, y);
          ctx.rotate(d.rot + Math.sin(time * 0.4 + d.phase) * 0.08);

          // Rich translucent crimson-orange oil pool

            -d.r * 0.2, -d.r * 0.2, d.r * 0.1,

          oilGrad.addColorStop(0.65, d.deepColor);
          oilGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(110, 15, 2, 0)');

          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse(0, 0, d.r, d.r * d.stretch, 0, 0, Math.PI * 2);

      function drawSteamAndAtmosphere(time, px, py) {
        ctx.save();
        ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen';

        // 1. Ambient Warm Overhead Glow (Volumetric God-Ray / Lamp Halo)
        const lampGlow = ctx.createRadialGradient(
          px * -25, -260 + py * -15, 20,
          0, -120, 560
        );
        lampGlow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255, 195, 125, 0.12)');
        lampGlow.addColorStop(0.45, 'rgba(235, 135, 65, 0.05)');
        lampGlow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)');
        ctx.fillStyle = lampGlow;
        ctx.fillRect(-600, -600, 1200, 900);

        // 2. Continuous Silky Steam Ribbons (Graceful S-curves that part around cursor)
        steamRibbons.forEach((rb, idx) => {
          const steps = 16;
          const pts = [];

          for (let s = 0; s <= steps; s++) {
            const t = s / steps; // 0 at broth, 1 high in air
            const y = rb.baseY - t * rb.height;
            const wave = Math.sin(t * 4.2 - time * rb.speed + rb.phase) * rb.swayAmp * Math.pow(t, 0.75);
            const secondHarmonic = Math.cos(t * 7.5 - time * rb.speed * 1.4 + idx) * (rb.swayAmp * 0.35) * t;
            let x = rb.baseX + wave + secondHarmonic - px * 25 * t;

            // Interactive mouse wind & wake deflection
            const dx = x - pointer.x;
            const dy = y - pointer.y;
            const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
            const influenceRadius = 155;
            if (dist < influenceRadius) {
              const falloff = Math.pow(1 - dist / influenceRadius, 2);
              // Push away from cursor + carry pointer velocity
              x += (dx / (dist + 12)) * falloff * 52 + pointer.vx * falloff * 1.3;
            }

            pts.push({ x, y, t });
          }

          // Draw multi-pass soft volumetric plume along the spline
          for (let s = 1; s < pts.length; s++) {
            const p0 = pts[s - 1];
            const p1 = pts[s];
            const env = Math.sin(p1.t * Math.PI) * (1 - p1.t * 0.35);
            const radius = rb.width * (0.45 + p1.t * 1.35);
            const alpha = rb.alpha * env;

            if (alpha > 0.002) {
              const segGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p1.x, p1.y, 2, p1.x, p1.y, radius);
              segGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 238, 218, ${alpha})`);
              segGrad.addColorStop(0.5, `rgba(245, 210, 175, ${alpha * 0.45})`);
              segGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(245, 210, 175, 0)');

              ctx.fillStyle = segGrad;
              ctx.beginPath();
              ctx.arc(p1.x, p1.y, radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
              ctx.fill();
            }
          }
        });

        // 3. Soft Billowing Steam Puffs (Advected by thermal updraft and mouse turbulence)
        steamPuffs.forEach((pf) => {
          if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
            pf.progress += pf.speed;
            if (pf.progress >= 1) {
              Object.assign(pf, createSteamPuff(Math.random, false));
            }

            const t = pf.progress;
            const naturalX = pf.startX + Math.sin(t * 5 + time * 0.6 + pf.phase) * pf.driftAmp * t;
            const targetY = pf.startY - t * 390;

            // Blend natural path with velocity advection
            pf.x += (naturalX - pf.x) * 0.04 + pf.vx;
            pf.y = targetY + pf.vy;
            pf.vx *= 0.94;
            pf.vy *= 0.94;

            // Mouse turbulence interaction
            const dx = pf.x - pointer.x;
            const dy = pf.y - pointer.y;
            const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
            if (dist < 140) {
              const force = Math.pow(1 - dist / 140, 1.8);
              pf.vx += ((dx / (dist + 10)) * 1.4 + pointer.vx * 0.06) * force;
              pf.vy += ((dy / (dist + 10)) * 0.8 + pointer.vy * 0.06) * force;
            }
          }

          const env = Math.sin(pf.progress * Math.PI) * (1 - pf.progress * 0.3);
          const curRadius = pf.r * (0.65 + pf.progress * 1.45);
          const alpha = pf.maxAlpha * env;

          if (alpha > 0.002) {
            const puffGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(pf.x, pf.y, 4, pf.x, pf.y, curRadius);
            puffGrad.addColorStop(0, `rgba(255, 242, 225, ${alpha})`);
            puffGrad.addColorStop(0.55, `rgba(240, 205, 175, ${alpha * 0.42})`);
            puffGrad.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(240, 205, 175, 0)');
            ctx.fillStyle = puffGrad;
            ctx.beginPath();
            ctx.arc(pf.x, pf.y, curRadius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
            ctx.fill();
          }
        });

        // 4. Tiny Warm Golden Micro-Droplets & Heat Motes rising in the warm backlight
        heatMotes.forEach((m, idx) => {
          if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
            m.y -= m.speedY;
            m.x += Math.sin(time * 0.8 + m.phase) * 0.25;
            if (m.y < -440) {
              m.y = 80;
              m.x = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 680;
            }
          }
          const twinkle = 0.6 + 0.4 * Math.sin(time * 2.2 + m.phase);
          const fade = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (m.y + 440) / 180)) * Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (120 - m.y) / 120));
          ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 205, 140, ${m.alpha * twinkle * fade})`;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.arc(m.x - px * 15, m.y - py * 10, m.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.fill();
        });

        ctx.restore();
      }

      // ==========================================
      // MAIN ANIMATION LOOP
      // ==========================================
      let lastTime = performance.now();
      let animTime = 12.5; // Start at an aesthetically balanced phase

      function render(now) {
        const dt = Math.min((now - lastTime) / 1000, 0.05);
        lastTime = now;

        if (!prefersReducedMotion) {
          animTime += dt;
        }

        // Smoothly interpolate pointer position and normalized tilt
        const prevX = pointer.x;
        const prevY = pointer.y;
        pointer.x += (pointer.targetX - pointer.x) * 0.12;
        pointer.y += (pointer.targetY - pointer.y) * 0.12;
        pointer.vx = (pointer.x - prevX) * 0.85 + pointer.vx * 0.15;
        pointer.vy = (pointer.y - prevY) * 0.85 + pointer.vy * 0.15;

        pointer.nx += (pointer.targetNx - pointer.nx) * 0.08;
        pointer.ny += (pointer.targetNy - pointer.ny) * 0.08;

        const px = prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : pointer.nx;
        const py = prefersReducedMotion ? 0 : pointer.ny;

        // Clear & Set Scene Transform
        ctx.setTransform(1, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0);
        ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);

        ctx.save();
        ctx.translate(centerX * dpr, centerY * dpr);
        ctx.scale(scale * dpr, scale * dpr);

        // Slight parallax shift of the entire camera with cursor
        ctx.translate(px * -10, py * -8);

        // 1. Dark Atmospheric Wood Table & Woven Bamboo Coaster
